value.titleZh: Vertiv · 官方業務進展
value.evidenceText: four new or expanding manufacturing facilities in the Americas
value.summary: Vertiv announced four manufacturing additions or expansions for power, integrated cabinets and infrastructure solutions serving high-density data centers.
value.summaryZh: Vertiv 宣布四處工廠新設或擴產，涵蓋高密度資料中心所需的電力、整合機櫃與基礎設施方案。
value.focus: Monitor manufacturing ramp and delivery of modular power and data-center fit-out equipment.
value.focusZh: 追蹤產能爬坡，以及模組電力與資料中心建置設備的交付進度。
value.risks: The announced regional capacity increase depends on facilities reaching full ramp; supply expansion is distinct from operating data-center ownership.

value.title: Bloom Energy and Oracle Expand Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 2.8 GW to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Build-Out
value.titleZh: Bloom Energy · 官方業務進展
value.evidenceText: an initial 1.2 GW of capacity has been contracted
value.summary: Bloom announced an Oracle master agreement for up to 2.8 GW of fuel cells, with 1.2 GW contracted and deployment continuing into 2027.
value.summaryZh: Bloom 公布 Oracle 燃料電池主協議，最高容量 2.8 GW，其中 1.2 GW 已簽約，部署持續至 2027 年。
value.focus: Track contracted capacity deployment and additional orders under the master agreement.
value.focusZh: 追蹤已簽約容量部署，以及主協議下新增訂單。
value.risks: The 2.8 GW ceiling exceeds the initially contracted 1.2 GW; phased deployment and additional procurement remain distinct from completed capacity.
value.risksZh: 2.8 GW 是協議上限，高於初始已簽約 1.2 GW；分期部署與後續採購不能等同已完成容量。

value.title: Applied Digital Signs 210 MW Lease at Delta Forge 2, Expanding Its AI Factory Franchise Model to a Fifth Campus
value.titleZh: Applied Digital · 官方業務進展
value.evidenceText: The agreement covers 210 MW of critical IT load under a 15-year take-or-pay structure
value.summary: Applied Digital announced a 210 MW critical IT lease at Delta Forge 2 with an investment-grade U.S. hyperscaler. The 15-year base term represents approximately $5.2 billion of contracted revenue.
value.summaryZh: Applied Digital 宣布 Delta Forge 2 與美國投資等級大型雲端業者簽訂 210 MW 關鍵 IT 負載租約，15 年基本租期約有 52 億美元合約收入。
value.focus: Monitor campus delivery and financing, distinguishing base-term commitments from optional renewals and utility power from critical IT load.
value.focusZh: 追蹤園區交付及融資，區分基本租期與選擇性續租，以及公用電力容量與關鍵 IT 負載。
value.risks: Contracted revenue is spread across future lease years; the larger renewal-inclusive value depends on options being exercised. Construction and customer acceptance remain execution milestones.
value.risksZh: 合約收入分布於未來租期；包含續租的較大金額須以選擇權實際行使為前提。建設與客戶驗收仍是執行重點。

value.title: Arista Introduces Next-Generation 1.6Terabit Portfolio for AI Fabrics
value.titleZh: Arista Networks · 官方業務進展
value.evidenceText: a new portfolio of 1.6T networking platforms
value.summary: Arista introduced 7060XE7 networking for rack-scale AI fabrics, with air-cooled 1.6T availability planned for Q4 2026 and other models for Q1 2027.
value.summaryZh: Arista 推出用於機架級 AI 網路的 7060XE7 系列；氣冷 1.6T 型號預計 2026 年第四季供貨，其他型號預計 2027 年第一季。

value.focusZh: 追蹤產品供貨與 AI scale-up、scale-out 網路的採用情況。
value.risks: This is a product launch with prospective availability dates, not evidence of commissioned data-center capacity or booked revenue.
value.risksZh: 這是附預期供貨時程的產品發布，不能視為資料中心容量已啟用或收入已入帳。

value.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook
value.titleZh: Equinix · 官方業務進展
value.evidenceText: Added a record 9,700 net interconnections in the quarter
value.summary: Equinix reported 11% monthly recurring revenue growth and 9,700 net interconnection additions in Q2. Capacity expansion included 52 projects in 33 markets, while 2026 capital expenditure guidance reached $5–6 billion.
value.summaryZh: Equinix 公布第二季月經常性收入成長 11%、淨增加 9,700 個互連連線；33 個市場共有 52 個擴建專案，2026 資本支出指引達 50 至 60 億美元。
value.focus: Track recurring revenue and interconnection growth alongside capacity delivery and capital spending; compare AFFO consistently after identifying one-time xScale fees.
value.focusZh: 追蹤經常性收入與互連成長，以及容量交付與資本支出；辨識一次性 xScale 費用後一致比較 AFFO。
value.risks: Quarterly revenue and AFFO included one-time xScale fees. AFFO is non-GAAP; higher construction spending and currency assumptions qualify management's outlook.
value.risksZh: 當季收入及 AFFO 包含一次性 xScale 費用。AFFO 為非 GAAP 指標，較高建設支出及匯率假設影響管理層展望。

value.titleZh: GE Vernova · 官方業務進展
value.evidenceText: including data centers, to the grid more quickly and reliably

value.risks: The announcement concerns grid equipment supply rather than a named data-center power contract; hiring and expansion milestones are prospective.
